A New Chapter for Sushi Tadokoro
We will be closed from October 1 through October 22 as we prepare for our new next chapter.
We will reopen on Friday, October 23 as an Omakase-only restaurant, offering a more intimate and refined Edomae dining experience.
We sincerely appreciate your patience and continued support during this transition, and we look forward to welcoming you to the New Sushi Tadokoro.

Edo-mae
sushi to
San Diego
, creating a unique experience through a careful selection of premium local and seasonal ingredients from around the world. Every piece is thoughtfully crafted, following years of expertise and honed skills to highlight the flavors and textures that define traditional Japanese sushi.

At the end of September, we will discontinue our lunch service and à la carte menu.
